joanna (sales): Heads-up — Acme POC demo just hit 429s mid-demo. Customers saw 'rate limit exceeded' during embeddings + chat burst. Tenant: acme-trial-56. Demo is live right now (16:30 PST). Any quick fixes?
samir (solutions-eng): Ugh. Can you grab the response headers / X-Request-Id from the failing call? Also a sample curl would help.
joanna (sales): here's the response we got from the agent: ```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2026 16:31:12 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: rq_0a1b2c3d
x-rate-limit-limit: 600/min
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
retry-after: 5

{"error":"rate limit exceeded"}
```
And the client call looked like: ```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME_TRIAL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"...single doc...","model":"embed-compact-v1"}'
```
joanna (sales): They were sending a bunch of small embedding calls in parallel from the browser demo — ~8 workers firing single-doc requests.
lee (eng-oncall): That header pattern + remaining=0 looks like per-route token/call cap exhaustion on trial tenants. Trial quotas are intentionally conservative. Are those 8 parallel workers doing many requests per second?
joanna (sales): yes, ~8 parallel, each triggering 10-20 calls during the demo flow.
tim (sre): Short term options: 1) reduce concurrency to 2–3 for the demo, 2) add exponential backoff + jitter on 429s, or 3) we can do a temporary per-route bump for acme-trial-56. Which do you want?
samir (solutions-eng): Also recommend batching embeddings server-side — sending arrays to /embeddings reduces overhead drastically. Example python batch: ```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="sk-ACME_TRIAL")
inputs = ["doc1","doc2","doc3"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-compact-v1", input=inputs)
```
That cuts calls from N to 1.
joanna (sales): please bump — demo is on-going, they want the walkthrough to finish.
opsbot (quota-bot): Quota change applied. per-route cap increased for tenant acme-trial-56 to 50r/s until 2222223333 + 2h. Case#4521.
lee (eng-oncall): thanks — I'll watch the per-route rejections and 429 rate on Console (console.redwood.ai/tenants/acme-trial-56/metrics). Let us know if it pops again.
joanna (sales): Demo resumed, no 429s now :thumbsup:. Customer asked about longer-term quota if they move forward.
samir (solutions-eng): For proposals we can offer: reserved capacity, higher per-minute quotas, or dedicated throughput. I'll draft the quota/pricing options and include batching guidance.
tim (sre): Quick follow-up: root cause = many small concurrent embedding calls hitting conservative trial per-route/token budgets. Action items: 1) Add POC checklist item advising batching + concurrency limits, 2) Provide client-side retry example, 3) Ops follow-up for quota options. I'll open a doc.
joanna (sales): Awesome — thanks everyone. Closing for now, will reopen if anything else shows up. cc @product for adding POC guidance to our docs.
